imageFileHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG. Up to 1.5 MB (SVG up to 256 KB).
imageUrlLabel: Or paste a permanent image address (https:// or ipfs://)
imageUrlNote: A pasted address is not copied. The NFT stays viewable only as long as that address does.
videoFileHint: MP4 or WebM, up to 20 MB. It never plays by itself.
coverHint: Required. Used as the NFT picture and shown before the video starts. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG.
filesFirst: Files and description are stored permanently first. Only then are you asked to sign.
previewEmpty: Choose a file to see the preview.
svgCleanNote: Scripts, links and external resources are removed from SVG. The stored copy can look slightly different from your original.
stageReady: Files saved. Now confirm in your wallet.
stageConfirmCreate: Confirm creating the collection in your wallet
stageConfirmMint: Confirm the mint in your wallet
stageWaitingTx: Waiting for the transaction to be confirmed…
resumeNotice: A previous attempt is still in progress. We will not mint twice.
errCoverRequired: Choose a cover image for the video.
errUnsupportedType: This file type is not supported. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG for images, MP4 or WebM for video.
errTooLarge: The file is too large. Images: 1.5 MB (SVG 256 KB). Video: 20 MB.
errContentMismatch: The file content does not match its type. Export it again in the format you chose.
errSvgRejected: This SVG cannot be used. Export a simple static SVG without scripts, animation or embedded images.
errVideoRejected: This video cannot be used. Save it as MP4 (H.264) or WebM and try again. QuickTime .mov is not supported.
errVideoVerifyUnavailable: The video was stored but could not be checked yet. Try again in a moment.
errStorageUnavailable: File storage is not available right now. Nothing was minted. Try again later.
errVideoStorageUnavailable: Video storage is not available right now. Use an image, or try again later.
errRateLimited: Too many uploads. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errNetwork: Network problem. Check your connection and try again.
errPinFailed: The file could not be stored. Try again.
errInvalidName: The name must be 2 to 200 characters.
errInvalidDescription: The description is too long (up to 8000 characters).
errInvalidUrl: The image address must start with https:// or ipfs://.
errWalletRejected: You declined the request in your wallet. Nothing was sent. You can try again.
errReverted: The transaction was mined but reverted. Nothing was minted and the fee was returned.
errNotCreator: This wallet did not create that collection, so the factory will not let it mint into it. Paste a collection you created, or switch to a single item.
errNotCollection: That address is not a collection made by this factory. Check it, or switch to a single item.
errFactoryMissing: The NFT factory is not deployed on this network yet.
errWrongNetwork: Your wallet is on a different network. Switch to PEOPLE Blockchain testnet and try again.
errTimeout: The transaction is taking too long. It was not sent again; use Continue to check it.
errUnknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was minted twice. Try again.
errStableFeeUnavailable: Stablecoin payment is temporarily unavailable. Please pay in PPL.
errStableDailyCap: Daily stablecoin payment limit reached for this wallet. Pay in PPL or try again tomorrow.
errInsufficientPpl: Not enough PPL: you need {needed} PPL (fee + gas) but have {balance} PPL.
errInsufficientPplGeneric: Not enough PPL to cover the fee and gas. Top up and try again.
errNetworkRpc: The network is not responding. Check your connection and try again.
createSuccessLead: The token is now live on PEOPLE Blockchain.
createTimeoutBody: Confirmation is taking longer than usual. Check the explorer and do not submit again. Use “Create another” only when you are sure nothing was created.
createTimeoutExplorer: Check your address in the explorer
